capabilities: Render Bible verses inline from {reference} syntax in Live Preview and Reading view
Compare two or more translations side by side
Show Strong's numbers with the STEPBible lexicon on King James verses
Bake verse text into notes as ordinary Markdown and refresh or strip it later
Link references to BibleGateway, BibleHub, Blue Letter Bible or Bible.com
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Verse text needs the network except for cached verses; the README recommends baking text for notes that must read offline. Free translations need no account or key; only ESV text requires a free key.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up scripture text and display it inside a note while writing.

relations.evidence: Text for the free translations comes from the HelloAO Bible API.
ESV text comes from the ESV API with your own key
Strong's numbers, transliterations and definitions come from the STEPBible lexicon (TBESH and TBESG)

summary: Bible verse lookup that renders {references} inline in notes with 15 free translations, comparison views, Strong's numbers, and baking into plain Markdown.
